name: bos-safe-autonomy-lab
required_prerequisites: all root submodules initialized at recorded gitlink SHAs
explicit funded test principals for testnet runs
secret-provider injection for signing or attestation tests
safety_invariants: never use mainnet credentials or value-bearing assets
never fabricate transaction IDs, signatures, attestations, or settlement success
fail closed when policy, oracle, attestation, revocation, or audit dependencies are unavailable
pause before irreversible or high-risk operations
record commit SHAs, tool versions, inputs, outputs, and failures
blockers: provider credentials, hardware TEE, and funded isolated principals require human provisioning
full cross-repository runner is not yet implemented
